unreachable_proofs: borrowed() never creates a BLOB; its TEXT borrows a valid Rust String, so bind() UTF-8 conversion cannot fail.
The decimal amount fast path multiplies at most u64::MAX by 10^19, below u128::MAX. The i64 conversion precedes signed negation; i64::MIN goes through the exact fallback.
Finite Decimal spellings are valid Rust float syntax, including underflow to signed zero and overflow to infinity. Their parse expects cannot fail after successful fixed formatting.
Entry cell() decimal access occurs only after prepare(); comparisons read metadata and typed decimals directly. The OnceCell second assignment is guarded by its initial get().

fixed_equal() only accepts ASCII digits/sign/point matching the validated Decimal coefficient and scale. Its matched ASCII and float parse expects follow that proof. Negative scale gives at least one fractional digit, so right.len()-1 cannot underflow.
Calculation models serialize only known serde-supported fields; String fmt::Write cannot fail. Checked integer/shape guards precede private scalar helpers in public compact encoding.
